title: Jewel Voice Broadcast (Gyokuon-hōsō) and Japanese surrender
note: Emperor Hirohito's radio address announcing Japan's acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration, terminating World War II in the Pacific.

title: Soviet invasion of Manchuria (Operation August Storm)
note: The massive Soviet offensive across Manchuria and northern territories that broke the Kwantung Army and acted in tandem with the atomic bombings to compel Japan's surrender.

title: Urakami Cathedral, Nagasaki
note: Spiritual center of the Hidden Christians (Kakure Kirishitan) in Kyushu, destroyed 500 meters from the hypocenter, and reconstructed as a monument to peace.

title: Korean atomic bomb victims in Hiroshima and Nagasaki
note: Tens of thousands of Korean forced and conscripted workers exposed to the atomic detonations in Hiroshima and Nagasaki, highlighting under-recorded colonial casualties and prolonged battles for survivor recognition.
